suppress.notes: CVE-2026-41855: Affects Spring Framework JMS converters (MappingJackson2MessageConverter / JacksonJsonMessageConverter). False positive / Non-applicable for this application: The application does NOT include spring-jms, has no JMS message broker connection, and does not deserialize JMS messages. Requires Spring Framework 6.2.19+ in full framework upgrade.

CVE-2026-47884: Affects org.springframework.web.servlet.view.xslt.XsltView when rendering dynamic XSLT views. False positive / Non-applicable for this application: The application is a pure REST JSON API utilizing @RestController and Jackson serialization. No XsltView or XSLT templates are configured or served. Requires Spring Framework 6.2.20+ in full framework upgrade.

CVE-2026-59313: Affects Spring Web MVC functional routing (RouterFunction) using ServerResponse.sse(). False positive / Non-applicable for this application: The application uses standard Spring MVC @RestController with JSON DTOs; no functional router functions or plain-text Server-Sent Event (SSE) streams are utilized.

CVE-2026-22748: Affects NimbusJwtDecoder / NimbusReactiveJwtDecoder when using withIssuerLocation(). False positive / Non-applicable for this application: The application uses a custom JJWT (io.jsonwebtoken) JwtTokenProvider with HMAC-SHA symmetric keys. Spring Security OAuth2 Resource Server and NimbusJwtDecoder are not included or used.

DOMPurify vulnerabilities embedded in swagger-ui-5.13.0.jar (webjar). Mitigated by architecture: Swagger UI and API docs are explicitly disabled in production (springdoc.swagger-ui.enabled=false, springdoc.api-docs.enabled=false). This frontend asset is never exposed to public or production clients.
